findings.category: CWE-664: Improper Control of a Resource Through its Lifetime
findings.evidence: docs/spec/isolation.md:126 requires effect records for longest advertised restore window plus 7 days and unresolved intents never expire; docs/spec/isolation.md:132 requires at least two completed full generations with dependent archives. recovery-design.md:16 says retain dependent chains, and reviews/recovery-test-strategy.md:13-14 tests bounded retention and missing base/WAL, but neither the recovery acceptance contract nor strategy names the two-full minimum or journal-retention versus advertised-window oracle.
findings.refutation: The V1 constitution remains binding and chain/journal checks appear elsewhere in the strategy, so this is not evidence that implementation accepts unsafe policy. However, a positive finite one-full policy or a journal TTL shorter than an otherwise valid advertised restore window can pass all explicitly named matrix oracles. Both safety floors need explicit acceptance cases before test authoring completes.
findings.suggestion: Add T-AC-35/T-AC-36 rejection of fewer than two retained completed full generations and dependent-WAL loss, and T-AC-40 denial of an advertised window exceeding durable effect evidence retention (plus 7 days); unresolved intents must remain retained. No destructive expiry is required.

satisfied_constraints: Physical clone retains source system_identifier and catalog/role names; new allocation, PGDATA/WAL and private mappings remain distinct.
Recovery hold is durable and enforced below routes across normal resume, grants, generic enqueue and broker/task proofs.
Default real activation stays unavailable; run-specific effect keys and Foundation epoch revocation cannot stand in for business-effect coverage or all-producer fencing.
Missing, truncated or empty synthetic journal evidence cannot establish complete non-rewound coverage.
Lost ACK/cancellation/provider drift preserve held target and reservations until definitive exact-scope read-only reconciliation.
Source is retained; nonempty/same/foreign targets and delta/force overwrite are forbidden; capacity covers both source and recovery obligations.
Actual target must be observed in paused recovery with explicit target/action and exact backup/repository.
Local lab success cannot qualify off-host repository, Docker/VM/firewall, hard quotas or complete production recovery.
